name: Adaptive Minds
description: We investigate a framework in which LoRA adapters are treated as callable tools that a base language model can dynamically select and invoke. We hypothesize that, when adapters are trained to provide strong domain-specific gains and are exposed with clear metadata, a base model can reliably route queries to the appropriate expert, effectively aggregating the benefits of many specialized adapters within a single framework. We introduce Adaptive Minds, a general framework within which we study both single-step routing and multi-step agentic reasoning.
